def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    import math

    S = 85
    K = 90
    r = 0.05
    T = 5
    c = 10
    p = 15

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    discounted_strike = K * math.exp(-r * T)
    dividend_discount_factor = (c - p + discounted_strike) / S
    implied_dividend_yield = -math.log(dividend_discount_factor) / T
    answer = round(implied_dividend_yield * 100, 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
